prompt: High fidelity desktop web application UI mockup, landscape 1440x900. A simple educational interactive WORLD MAP of present-day country geography. Map consumes 97 percent of screen. Flat map projection centered at longitude 10 showing the Americas left, Europe Africa middle, Asia right, Australia lower right; recognizable accurately shaped continents, each country outlined with fine contrasting borders and country names labeled where space allows; country labels small but readable sans-serif. NO historical events, no timeline, no sidebars, no cards, no illustrations, no fake terrain, no dashboard, no large heading. Design direction classroom screen: very pale blue-gray oceans #edf3f5, uniform muted sage land #d4dfd2, fine slate borders, dark slate labels #283b42. Top left a small white rectangular title plaque 'World map' with smaller 'Present-day countries'. Right edge near lower corner a white slim vertical control group '+' and '−', below a small reset icon button. Bottom left tiny 'Natural Earth' attribution. System sans typography, crisp utilitarian controls, abundant geographic space, even daylight. This is a working map UI composition preview, not a poster. Show the entire world at an overview zoom with selected major-country names such as CANADA, BRAZIL, CHINA, INDIA and AUSTRALIA. Core visual focus is the geographic map itself.
purpose: Design preview only; not geographic evidence
approval: User selected Classroom screen — sage land with strong borders.
